purpose: Home-office deduction and IRC 280A(g) Augusta-rule rental exclusion calculator ported from ApexLogics Apex #139 (AL-146). From a square-footage and expense profile it computes the regular-method deduction, the Rev. Proc. 2013-13 simplified-method deduction ($5 per square foot, 300 square feet maximum), the better of the two, the day-count test for the 14-day rental exclusion, and the resulting tax benefits at the stated rates. Declared deviations from the source, all flagged: the gross-income cap applies to both methods; the simplified method is not selectable for an S-corp owner-employee (Rev. Proc. 2013-13 section 4.02); non-finite inputs are refused by name. Disclosed open legal question: IRC section 280A(g)(1) may bar the corporate rent deduction that the source books for an S corporation. The tool retains the source figure under a flag and does not decide the question. Verify-only: it reads no calendar, tests only the day count for section 280A(g), models no Form 8829, and is an estimate, not tax advice.
